decisions.reason: The encrypted secondary channel was launched only a year ago and its value is still uncertain, and as a software feature built on the existing security platform it costs little to keep open.
Demand for mobile PDF signatures in Germany is growing with eIDAS-driven digitization, so the option has clear upside and low maintenance cost while uncertainty resolves.
The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture likely underpins the firm's core offering, so dropping it would cost a lot and keeping it costs little.
The email-to-app delivery robot is a niche bridging feature with uncertain adoption, but after only one year there is not yet enough evidence to justify abandoning a cheap option.

The QR-code hardware token carries higher carrying costs through hardware and logistics and faces competition from app-based authentication, but one year of results is too early to show its value will not be realized.
Payment network security compliance such as PSD2 and PCI is a regulation-driven market with steady demand, which makes this option worth keeping open.
